persona: Priya, raising a small seed round
goal: Make a 6-slide PowerPoint pitch deck for a mobile dog grooming startup: title, problem, solution, market, business model, ask. Short bullet points on each slide. Save it as {dir}\dog-grooming-pitch.pptx
Design a simple logo for a coffee cart called Bean There as an SVG file: a coffee cup icon and the name, two colors, square 512 by 512. Save it as {dir}\bean-there-logo.svg

persona: Kim, runs a small candle shop online
goal: Write an HTML email template for a candle shop's fall sale: a header, a hero line, three product blocks with name, price and a button, and a footer with an unsubscribe link placeholder. Use inline styles and tables so it works in email apps. Save it as {dir}\fall-sale-email.html

persona: Marcus, warehouse lead moving into operations
goal: Write a one-page resume as a Word document for a warehouse lead with 6 years of experience moving into an operations coordinator role: summary, skills, experience with 3 jobs and bullet results, education. Use a made-up name and city. Save it as {dir}\operations-resume.docx

Build a tiny Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that counts the words in the text you select on any page and shows the count in a small popup when you click the toolbar button. Save manifest.json, popup.html and popup.js in {dir}

Make an Excel invoice template for a handyman business: business name and client details at the top, a line items table (description, hours, rate, amount where amount is a formula of hours times rate) with 8 rows, then subtotal, 8.75 percent sales tax and total, all as formulas. Save it as {dir}\handyman-invoice.xlsx

Write a short business plan for a taco food truck in Sacramento: summary, menu and pricing, target customers, locations and schedule, startup costs table, monthly costs table, and a simple break-even estimate. Save it as {dir}\taco-truck-plan.md

Write a PowerShell script that creates a Windows scheduled task named Daily Desktop Cleanup which runs every day at 6 PM and moves files older than 30 days from the Desktop into a Desktop\Old Files folder. The script should support a -WhatIf switch that only shows what it would do and does not create the task. Save it as {dir}\desktop-cleanup.ps1

Write a Python program that makes a 10-question multiplication quiz worksheet with an answer key: it prints the worksheet and the answer key, uses a fixed random seed so the same worksheet comes out each time, and uses only the standard library. Save it as {dir}\times_quiz.py

persona: Dev, building a booking app prototype
goal: Write a small Node.js HTTP server (only built-in modules) for a booking app prototype: GET /slots returns a JSON list of 8 sample time slots, POST /book with a slot id marks it booked and returns the slot, and unknown paths return 404 JSON. Include a self-test: when run with --test it starts on a random port, calls both endpoints, prints 'self-test passed' and exits. Save it as {dir}\booking-server.js
